title: Campus Lead (x2 Positions)
summary: Two site-based Campus Leads are required: one in the Netherlands and one in Central Europe, each overseeing a major infrastructure campus.
description: Two site-based Campus Leads are required: one in the Netherlands and one in Central Europe, each overseeing a major infrastructure campus.

sections.heading: Main Duties and Responsibilities
items: Take senior on-site responsibility for campus delivery, programme and operations.
Direct Project Managers, Package Managers and multidisciplinary site teams.
Control campus-wide schedules, budgets, resources and milestones.
Maintain client relationships and rigorous health, safety and quality standards.

sections.heading: Qualifications and Experience
items: Extensive site leadership on large multi-package construction, MEP or data centre projects.
Experience coordinating multiple Project Managers and trade packages.
Unrestricted right to work in EU without sponsorship.

sections.heading: Package & Benefits
items: Travel and accommodation covered, plus a tax-free monthly subsistence allowance as stated in the supplied role document.
